summary: Volato Group filed an 8-K on October 8, 2026, reporting an equity line of credit (ELOC) purchase agreement with DFU, LLC, giving the company the right, not obligation, to issue up to $1,000,000,000 of Class A common stock over a 36-month investment period beginning upon effectiveness of the resale registration statement. Puts are capped at $6,000,000 per notice, two per trading day, priced at a discount to market with a $0.21 floor, and aggregate issuance capped at 19.99% of outstanding shares absent stockholder approval. Watch dilution and pricing overhang.
